status: пилот 16.11.2026 — блок city/4, тексты пишет ассистент, ученик просматривает
note: Материал урока для модели: мини-сцена (4-6 реплик), вопросы ТОЛЬКО по сцене, фразы, которые ученик должен уметь сказать сам. Модель этот текст НЕ сочиняет и НЕ меняет (решение 67). id совпадает с knowledge_base/curriculum.json. Вопросы в ask — про то, что было в сцене, а не про жизнь ученика. Пустой/отсутствующий урок — прежнее поведение промпта.

city/4.1.title: Bigger than / the biggest

phrases.en: The blue house is bigger than the yellow one.
phrases.why: bigger — сравниваем ДВА предмета: к короткому слову + er.

phrases.ru: Это самый большой дом на улице.
phrases.en: This is the biggest house on the street.
phrases.why: the biggest — самый большой среди всех: the + слово + est.

phrases.en: My flat is smaller than yours.
phrases.why: smaller than — «меньше, чем»: после than ставим второе.

phrases.en: It is more expensive than that one.
phrases.why: more expensive — длинное слово, поэтому more, а не -er.
Which one is better? — better — особая форма от good.

phrases.en: This is the best choice for a family.
phrases.why: the best — превосходная степень от good.

scene.en: Look at these two houses. The blue one is bigger.
Yes, but the yellow one is newer.
And the blue house has the biggest garden on the street.
But it is more expensive than the yellow one.
So which house is better for a family?

ask: Which house is bigger, the blue one or the yellow one?
Which house has the biggest garden?
Which house would you take and why?

city/4.2.title: Better or worse?

phrases.en: This phone is better than that one.

phrases.why: worse — тоже особая форма, от bad.

phrases.en: It is cheaper, but not better.
phrases.why: cheaper, but not better — сравниваем две вещи в одной фразе.

phrases.en: Which phone is better for you?
phrases.why: better for you — после better можно уточнить, для кого.

phrases.en: The battery is worse than before.
phrases.why: worse than before — сравниваем с тем, как было раньше.

phrases.en: This one is good enough for me.

scene.en: Look, two phones! This one is cheaper.
But that one is better. And it is smaller.
My old phone was worse than both of them.
This one takes better photos, but the battery is worse.
So the cheap one is good enough for me.
And which one do you like more?

ask: Which phone would you take and why?
What is worse about the cheap phone?
Was Ann's old phone better or worse than these two?

city/4.3.title: Two phones: which one?

phrases.why: Which one is better? — вопрос про выбор из двух.

phrases.en: It is more expensive than that one.
phrases.why: more expensive than that one — длинное слово: more.
The small one is cheaper — the small one = тот маленький.
I will take this one — «возьму этот».
Is there a cheaper phone? — вопрос с there is.

phrases.en: This one has a better camera.
phrases.why: This one has a better camera — better перед словом.

scene.en: Yes, I need a phone. Which one is better?
This one is more expensive, but the camera is better.
And the small one? It is cheaper.
It is cheaper, but the battery is worse.
OK, I will take the black one.

ask: What is worse about the small phone?
Would you take the expensive phone or the cheap one?
